live_scenarios.name: Local TLS API: mapped EMU accounts read private PRs per owner and never grant merge authority
Local TLS API: absent mapping and unmapped owners retain ambient identity and merge readiness

setup_adjustments: Initial fixture attempts used too few polling cycles or a 40-second driver timeout. The final run used a bounded polling loop and a larger driver timeout, with no product changes.
